notes: • Deliver Bundle: package a produced bundle as a password-protected ZIP — AES-256 (opens with 7-Zip, WinZip, WinRAR, Keka) or the compatible traditional encryption that opens everywhere — and save it straight into Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, pCloud, OneDrive, iCloud Drive or any folder your cloud client syncs. Suggested strong passwords, one-click copy, and every archive is verified before it's handed to you. Available on the bundle wizard's finish page and under File ▸ Deliver Bundle as Encrypted ZIP… for bundles produced earlier.
